scope: All 35 unique Chabot sending courses in the four supplied articulation datasets, including alternatives/electives. CSUEB receiving-course prerequisites are not covered.
temporal_scope: Research snapshot on 2026-09-24; source years are explicit. Articulation agreement years remain unchanged. Some evidence is from 2025-2026 or older effective outlines and is not current-year certification.

semantics.NONE: No mandatory prerequisite listed in cited evidence, not an assertion about every registration restriction.
semantics.COURSE: Course completion or enrollment according to timing.
semantics.before_or_concurrent: Earlier completion OR enrollment in the same term.
semantics.same_term: Must enroll together; not a strict DAG edge.
semantics.CONDITION: Requires external confirmation; do not automatically treat as satisfied.
semantics.null_requirement: Unresolved; use proposed_requirement only for review, never for automatic eligibility.
semantics.minimum_grade: Present only where explicitly supported; missing does not imply any passing grade qualifies.
semantics.policy_satisfied: A prerequisite naming one of these courses is satisfied by published college policy; the course is never scheduled automatically, and the rule is reported for review.
